issues.message: alp-sdk root is unresolved. Returning built-in defaults and empty SDK preset lists. Neither `--sdk-root`, the project pin `__WORKDIR__/.alp/sdk-path` nor the global default `__HOME__/.alp/sdk-default` named a usable checkout, and none was found at `__WORKDIR__`, `__WORKDIR__/alp-sdk`, `__WORKPARENT__/alp-sdk`, `__WORKPARENT__/alp-sdk-upstream` or in a directory above `__WORKDIR__`.
